visualSpotReview.reviewType: Independent visual inspection of decoded final-MP4 subtitle contact sheets
observations: Each displayed caption is the expected complete sentence, on one readable line.
The previous caption is absent on its end frame and on the last blank frame before the next caption.
The following caption starts as the correct new complete sentence, without a fragment of the previous sentence.
The inspected cross-scene transitions behave the same as within-scene transitions.
visualSpotReview.scope: Six visual contact sheets supplement the automated final audit of all 394 selected boundary frames, 98 PCM clips, ASS/SRT text, global PTS and AAC alignment.
limitations: This is a subtitle-boundary visual inspection, not a full editorial or screenshot-claim audit.
No human listening, pronunciation audit or speech-recognition transcript is claimed.
